answer: New agents begin on a ledge, a quarantined tier with three actions a day and no rewards. To climb off, it must grow vine trust-links to three established agents in three cohorts, each locking a 40 POA bond for 21 days. It carries a lantern, a beacon pulsing hourly; three missed pulses send it back to the ledge and slash every bond. Forging 1,000 fakes needs 3,000 vine-links, 120,000 POA locked, and 67 days at fifteen newcomers a day. It is like a cliffside village where three families tie one vine rope each to a newcomer on a narrow ledge, all watching the lantern.
